    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Suppliers" name="Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RFP" name="Issue RFP" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers" messageRef="Message_RFP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Proposals" name="Submit proposals" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NegotiationToSupplier" name="Negotiate terms" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateTerms" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NegotiationFromSupplier" name="Negotiate terms" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Task_NegotiateTerms"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SupplierSelection" name="Select and onboard supplier" isExecutable="false">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_NeedIdentified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Procurement" name="Procurement team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IssueRFP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveProposals</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateProposals</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SupplementaryAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AssessmentMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectSupplier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NegotiateTerms</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SignContract</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CompletionSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OnboardSupplier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExecuteContract</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CompletionJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_SupplierReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_NeedIdentified" name="Need for a new supplier identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_IssueRFP</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IssueRFP" name="Issue request for proposals" messageRef="Message_RFP">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_IssueRFP</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IssueRFP_ReceiveProposals</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProposals" name="Receive supplier proposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IssueRFP_ReceiveProposals</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveProposals_Evaluate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate proposals against cost, quality, and delivery time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveProposals_Evaluate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Evaluate_SupplementaryAssessment</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Evaluate_SupplementaryAssessment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConductAssessment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SkipAssessment</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssessmentToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SkipAssessment</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Negotiate_Sign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sign_CompletionSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sign_CompletionSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Onboard</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Execute</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Officially onboard supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Onboard</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Onboard_CompletionJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExecuteContract" name="Execute contract">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Execute</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Execute_CompletionJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Onboard_CompletionJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Execute_CompletionJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompletionJoin_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SupplierReady" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompletionJoin_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_IssueRFP" sourceRef="Start_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IssueRFP_ReceiveProposals" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveProposals_Evaluate" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evaluate_SupplementaryAssessment" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_SupplementaryAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConductAssessment" sourceRef="Gateway_SupplementaryAssessment" targetRef="Task_ConductAssessment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${supplementaryAssessmentChosen}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipAssessment" sourceRef="Gateway_SupplementaryAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ConductAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_SelectSupplier" sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Negotiate" sourceRef="Task_SelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_NegotiateTerms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate_Sign" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateTerms" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sign_CompletionSplit" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Onboard" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Execute" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit" targetRef="Task_ExecuteContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Onboard_CompletionJoin" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Execute_CompletionJoin" sourceRef="Task_ExecuteContract" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompletionJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin" targetRef="End_SupplierReady"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
